decisions.decision: The former fixed one-message first-round questionnaire answer is historical. The active contract uses the current runtime/database settings and server-owned ordered account/contact read model.
decisions.safety_boundary: Provider approval, health, idempotency, receipt, mailbox reconciliation, and stop conditions remain required for real sends.

decisions.decision: A and B are Mailspring plugins; the external database is the only durable store. The forward loop is A journal to DB read model to B send to Mailspring event to A journal. No B-to-DB ACK edge is part of the contract.
decisions.safety_boundary: A readiness/heartbeat loss revokes Mailspring connectivity and pauses B; unknown observations pause and reconcile without resend.
